text: Lets AI assistants connect to and query your Supabase projects on your behalf
quote: Once connected, your AI assistants can interact with and query your Supabase projects on your behalf.

text: CLI commands (init, start) spin up a full local Supabase stack in two steps
quote:
With two commands, you can set up and start a new local project:
1. `supabase init` to create a new local project
2. `supabase start` to launch the Supabase services

text: Supports self-hosting for full data control, compliance needs, or isolated environments
quote: Self-hosting is a good fit if you need full control over your data, have compliance requirements that prevent you from using managed services, or want to run Supabase in an isolated environment.

text: Row Level Security lets you write granular per-row authorization rules inside Postgres
quote: Postgres Row Level Security (RLS) gives you granular authorization rules that run inside the database.

text: Broadcast channel sends low-latency messages between clients for messaging, cursors, game events, notifications
quote: Broadcast: Send low-latency messages between clients. Perfect for real-time messaging, database changes, cursor tracking, game events, and custom notifications.

text: Presence feature tracks and syncs online/active user state across clients
quote: Presence: Track and synchronize user state across clients. Ideal for showing who's online, or active participants.

text: Postgres Changes lets clients listen to database row changes in real time
quote: Listen to database changes in real-time.

text: Built-in auth supports password, magic link, OTP, social login, and SSO
quote: Your users can use many popular Auth methods, including password, magic link, one-time password (OTP), social login, and single sign-on (SSO).

text: Storage service manages files of any size with fine-grained access controls and optimized delivery
quote: Supabase Storage is a robust, scalable solution for managing files of any size with fine-grained access controls and optimized delivery.

text: Edge Functions run server-side TypeScript code distributed globally near users
quote: Edge Functions are server-side TypeScript functions, distributed globally at the edge—close to your users.

text: Open source toolkit for building AI apps using Postgres and pgvector, including vector similarity search
quote: Supabase provides an open source toolkit for developing AI applications using Postgres and pgvector.

text: Branching creates isolated preview environments to test schema/config changes before production
quote: You can use these branching environments to create and test changes like new configurations, database schemas, or features without affecting your production setup.

text: Generates TypeScript types (database.types.ts) directly from your schema
quote: Generate types for your project to produce the `database.types.ts` file

text: Compute can scale up to 64 cores and 256GB RAM
quote:
Scale compute up to  
64 cores and 256 GB RAM

text: Positions itself as an open-source, enterprise-grade alternative offering Firebase-like features
quote: We're building the features of Firebase using enterprise-grade open source tools.

text: Auto-generates instant, ready-to-use REST APIs from your database
quote: Instant ready-to-use REST APIs.

text: Auto-generates a GraphQL API alongside REST
quote:
Auto-generated APIs.
  - [x] REST. [Docs]
  - [x] GraphQL. [Docs]
  - [x] Realtime subscriptions.

text: Runs the entire Supabase backend stack locally via CLI, including in CI environments
quote: The Supabase CLI enables you to run the entire Supabase stack locally, on your machine or in a CI environment.

text: Storage file permissions can be managed with row-level security and custom policies
quote: Fine-grained Access Control - Manage file permissions with row-level security and custom policies

text: Recommends Docker as the fastest way to self-host the full stack
quote: The fastest and recommended way to self-host Supabase is to use Docker.

text: APIs are generated via database introspection to produce type-safe API definitions
quote: Supabase APIs are generated from your database, which means that we can use database introspection to generate type-safe API definitions.
